subject.title: feat: expose ClawHub catalog feed lanes

question: Should ClawHub expose these root feed lanes as a live public API now, and if so should they be served from stored publications with distinct feed IDs and an explicit reviewed-lane trust contract?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a narrow code repair: it changes public API/feed identity, client trust semantics, and unauthenticated availability behavior that require maintainer product and operations intent.

options.title: Publish From Stored Snapshots
options.body: Move the new root lanes onto `catalogFeedPublications` or an equivalent quota-protected cached publication path before exposing public routes.

options.title: Approve Live Root Feeds
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept dynamic feed reads, reviewed-lane semantics, and feed-ID compatibility after documenting the boundary and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Pause The Feed Stack
options.body: Keep the draft paused or close it if the cross-repository feed RFC and OpenClaw consumer contract are not ready to anchor ClawHub producer behavior.

recommendation.title: Publish From Stored Snapshots
recommendation.body: Move the new root lanes onto `catalogFeedPublications` or an equivalent quota-protected cached publication path before exposing public routes.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the hosted feed publication contract and routes that vincentkoc introduced and hardened.
